title: Decisive-test timeline: LZ, XENONnT, PandaX-4T, XLZD and CaWO4 through 2028-2032 -- when does each interpretation of the 248 keV event get a 3 sigma / 5 sigma verdict?
question: For A (inelastic O1, 1 TeV, delta = 300/350/366/380 keV), B (L10) and C (one-off), at what calendar date do LZ, XENONnT, PandaX-4T, their sum, XLZD and CaWO4 reach 3/5 sigma by counting, with what probability is the question settled (BF > 100 either way) by end-2027/2028/2030, when do nulls push P(DM) below 1e-3, and when can A be separated from B by shape, timing, tungsten or isotopes?
headline_result: At LZ's best-fit rate the present xenon generation reaches a 5 sigma population-vs-one-off verdict (new data only) by Apr 2027 for L10 and already holds it for delta >= 350 keV, with P(settled by end-2028) = 0.91/0.62/0.98/1.0 (L10/d300/d350/d366); at x0.30 only XLZD decides (2033); zero events push P(DM) from 0.015 below 1e-3 by Aug 2027
key_numbers: unexamined 17.9 t.yr hold 2.2/1.1/3.2/4.9 events (P0 0.12/0.32/0.04/0.007); 2 events = 4.3 sigma new-only, BF>100; 5 sigma medians present gen 600 phd Apr 2027/Apr 2030/on disk/on disk, 1000 phd on disk/May 2028; P(5sigma by end-2027) 0.63/0.24/0.85/0.98, end-2028 0.78/0.36/0.94/0.995, x0.30 by end-2028 0.13/0.03/0.27/0.52; LZ alone L10 Oct 2031 (600) / Apr 2027 (1000); LZ sideband 9.6 t.yr expects 3.6/13/103 at delta 350/366/380, SR3 P0 = 0.02 (366); XLZD 5 sigma Mar/Aug/Feb/Jan 2032, Feb 2033 at x0.30; null P(DM)<1e-3 Aug 2027 (L10), Nov 2030 (d300), BF<1/100 needs 75 t.yr; shape on disk; timing 3 sigma on disk (d366)/Apr 2028 (d350)/never (d300); CaWO4 10 kg.yr 2.8/0.37/0.03 events, P(3 sigma) 0.62/0.03/0.004; 136Xe pair 4.3 yr of a 5 t enriched TPC
model_or_mechanism: inelastic O1 (delta 300-380 keV) vs L10 vs one-off; counting, Gamma-Poisson Bayes factors, P034 timing, P057/P050 shape, P046 tungsten, P047 isotopes
confidence: medium - rates and requirements are corpus-validated; calendar rests on recalled exposures, live fractions and XLZD timing
